vix

adverb

In this lexicon

  • hardly

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 16.24.2: ego vix teneor quīn accurram (Lewis & Short); Caes. BG 2.28: ex hominum mīlibus LX vix ad D sēsē redāctōs esse dīxērunt (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • ego vix teneor quīn accurram

    I can hardly keep myself from running to youCic. Fam. 16.24.2 (Lewis & Short)

    but now I can hardly catch him when he runs, and in a few days I won’t be able toSen. Ep. 83.4

    In the entry for hardly
